title: Padam (I--IV)
text: 1. Sāvatthi || || 2. Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yāni kānici jaṅgamānaṃ pāṇānam padajātāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti || hatthipadaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idam mahantattena || evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā || appamādo tesaṃ dhammānam aggam akkhāyati || || 3. Appamattassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati a- a- maggam bahulīkarissati || pe || ||
